description: The tmux driver lanes: one record per lane, read by the context guard (scripts/ops/context_guard.py), the boot relaunch (scripts/ops/lane_relaunch.py) and any keeper through scripts/ops/driver_lanes.py. Launchers are repo-relative. A Codex lane may set account to a loader label (sub for account a, b-sub for account b); a Codex lane with no account is account a (sub). The home directory stays in the ignored local config named in docs/runbooks/maintenance-window.md (#10814).

lanes.name: infra
lanes.kick: Resume as the Infra driver from the NEWEST HANDOFF at the top of .claude/infra-epic/DRIVER-STATE.md. Consume your claude-infra Fleet inbox first, adopt the in-flight workers listed in the handoff (do not restart them), then continue the recorded chains. Never /compact; hand off before 70% context.

lanes.kick: Resume as the kube-dojo driver from the NEWEST HANDOFF at the top of .claude/kube-dojo-epic/DRIVER-STATE.md. Consume your claude-kube-dojo Fleet inbox first, adopt the in-flight workers listed in the handoff (do not restart them), then continue the recorded chains on kube-dojo/kube-dojo.github.io epic #2272, dispatching every kube-dojo worker with --repo kube-dojo through the dispatcher the lane instruction names. Never /compact; hand off before 70% context.

lanes.name: cto
lanes.kick: Resume as the combined CTO and cross-epic lead. Read .claude/epics-epic/DRIVER-STATE.md first (short and authoritative). Load core and Fleet Comms rules, drain recipients epics and cto, verify the tmux lanes are live and tasked in priority order, and continue the loop. Never run /compact; hand off before 70% context. Timestamps only from date -u.
